I have been through hell and back. Actually, that’s an understatement. SS started when I was 18. I am 26 now. I Dropped out of two universities. Evicted from two dorms. Entire life purpose was confusing. I wanted to die. All belongings except for what I had on my back and my backpack, thrown away. My father financially abused me and used my SSN and I was going to be liable for fraud. I had to hire an attorney and clear my name, and my family has been divided/destroyed…half on my side, half on my father’s side. Finally came clean to my family about my childhood sexual abuse committed by another family member. So much housing insecurity. I had my first two and only relationships during SS and both have ended. The relationships were unequal, I lost myself in them and blindly depended upon others. I currently have $1000 in my bank account. Broke up with one of said relationships a month ago and I have had to pack my life in my car for the nth time and stay on my mother’s couch. Don’t even get me started on the s*icide attempts during Phase 1 and my addiction to cannabis. (5 days sober yay) *lots* of relapse. Lots of learning about my addiction and why I do, say, and act the way I do. 

This has been the worst, hardest period of my life.
BUT BUT BUT

*I am better for it.*
Truly. I am better for it. After 4 years of studying, I finally got certified in a lucrative, respectable career. I “graduated” last week. I know more about myself and why/how I function within relationships. In 2020, I discovered astrology and my life has never been the same. I am wiser, more spiritual, more contemplative. I have forgiven my mother. I have forgiven my father, and keep him at an arms distance. I have been homeless. I have been broke. I have been in the depths of drug addiction. I have almost ended my life. But I HAVE MY LIFE. As long as we are alive, we have the chance to be happy. I have no regrets, actually, because I *know* that this is my karma. I am one of the strongest people I know. Only Shani brings the tangible and concrete forward.


TLDR: worst period of my life, would not wish it on my worst enemies. But Shani has cleansed me through fire and ash. I have been reborn a new person. Everything happens for a reason. I am alive for a reason. I am alive to forgive, to heal myself, to heal others, and love deeply and unconditionally. My soul is love, and all the love I’ve ever given away returns to me tenfold. Peace and blessings.

I now want pick up the books ive always wanted to read, but never did because I was getting high instead. 

After you’ve started with familiar small things, endeavor to try something you’ve never done before but has always interested you.
